attributes.rule: <abbr title='Change of tariff heading'>CTH</abbr>: All non-originating materials used in the production of the good have undergone a change in tariff classification at the 4-digit level (tariff heading) except from [subheading 730120](/subheadings/7301200000-80).
A maximum of **50%** of the ex-works price (EXW) is made up of non-originating parts (MAXNOM).
Your goods contain a Regional Value Content (RVC) of at least **55%** of the Free on Board (FOB) cost of the goods.
